top_signals.title: Trump's Russia-Ukraine Energy Ceasefire May Only Cover Oil Refineries
top_signals.summary: President Trump's announcement of an energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine appears to be considerably narrower than initially suggested, with a White House official telling Axios that the proposal only covers attacks on oil refineries and with no official confirmation from Moscow as of yet. Trump announced the apparent breakthrough on social media on Sunday, describing it broadly as an energy ceasefire and claiming the agreement was to go into effect immediately.  Effective Immediately: An ENERGY CEASEFIRE in the War between Russia and…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Healey rules out expanding mansion tax to £1.5m homes
top_signals.summary: John Healey has ruled out widening Labour’s so-called mansion tax to cover homes worth £1.5m, following warnings that the tax change would hammer middle-class homeowners in the capital.  The Chancellor had been considering widening its council tax surcharge to cover homes valued at £1.5m or more, as the Treasury seeks extra revenue to fund cost [...]

top_signals.title: Malaysia Budget Sees Consumer Names Emerge Winners, Analysts Say
top_signals.summary: Consumer stocks are among the biggest beneficiaries of Malaysia’s spending plan for 2027, boosted by higher allocations to improve households’ purchasing power, according to analysts.
